description: Lease one account from the pool for browser login, EXCLUSIVELY, until you release it or the lease expires. No other session can be handed the same account while you hold it. You MUST call release_account with the returned lease_token when finished. If your task may run longer than the lease TTL, call renew_lease periodically to keep it.

holder.description: A label for who is holding it (e.g. a Jira ticket id). Observability only.

pool.description: Which pool to lease from, e.g. "realtor" or "admin".

ttl_seconds.description: Lease lifetime in seconds. Defaults to the server default TTL.

wait_ms.description: Override the block-and-wait timeout for this call. 0 = fail fast on an empty pool.

name: lease_account
